component.name: Linux OneDrive
component.summary: Unofficial OneDrive client with files on demand

description.p: Linux OneDrive brings your whole OneDrive to a folder on your computer. Files appear instantly and download only when you open them, like Files On-Demand on Windows. Changes sync in the background, conflicting edits keep both versions, and accidental mass deletions are held until you confirm.
